papers.title: ActivityNarrated: An Open-Ended Narrative Paradigm for Wearable Human Activity Understanding
papers.what: Reframes wearable HAR around open-ended natural-language narratives with a multi-position IMU dataset, a sensor-language retrieval evaluation, and the ActNarrator model, which nearly doubles Macro-F1 over closed-set baselines as a downstream task.
papers.builds_on: Sensor2Text (Chen 2024, ELYUE3NF); SSL for HAR (Yuan 2024, RTMH75VW)

papers.title: AnyPPG: An ECG-Guided PPG Foundation Model Trained on Over 100,000 Hours of Recordings
papers.what: A PPG foundation model pretrained on over 100,000 hours of synchronized PPG-ECG from 58,796 participants, using ECG as guidance; it gains 12.8% on regression and 9.1% on classification over the next-best model across 11 tasks and screens 1,014 ICD-10 categories.

papers.title: SignalMC-MED: A Multimodal Benchmark for Evaluating Biosignal Foundation Models on Single-Lead ECG and PPG
papers.what: A benchmark of 22,256 visits with paired 10-minute ECG and PPG over 20 clinical tasks, finding domain-specific models beat general time-series models, ECG+PPG fusion helps, longer signals help, bigger models do not reliably help, and hand-crafted features stay competitive.

papers.title: Foundation Models Defining A New Era In Sensor-based Human Activity Recognition: A Survey And Outlook
papers.what: Reviews 132 papers on foundation models for sensor-based HAR with a lifecycle taxonomy across input, pretraining, adaptation, and utilization, naming three directions: HAR-specific models, adapted general time-series and multimodal models, and LLMs for reasoning and interaction.
